title: AOS Live Use: Structured Action Logging
abstract: Using the upgraded AOS to log the actions from the previous tick.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 83

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="update_meta",
    target="meta_prompt",
    metadata={"new_objective": "Develop adapter.py"}
)

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="admin_aos",
    target="task_list",
    metadata={"action": "update_tasks", "eval_id": 194, "completed": 21, "activated": 22}
)

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="create_code",
    target="adapter.py",
    metadata={"purpose": "Initial skeleton"}
)

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="log_actions",
    target="tick_82",
    metadata={"eval_id": 195}
)

print("Structured logging complete.")
